metadata.title: LineME - Queue Management App
metadata.description: Skip physical waiting. Join and manage queues digitally in real time.

hero.title: Welcome to LineME
hero.subtitle: Businesses create a digital waiting line and share a code. Visitors join from their phone, see their position, and arrive when their turn is close.
hero.primaryDescription: Enter a code and see your live position.
hero.secondaryDescription: Set up a digital queue for your service.

faq.title: What does LineME do?
faq.subtitle: The simple version, before you get started.

what.question: What is LineME?
what.answer: LineME replaces a physical waiting line with a digital one. People can wait wherever they are instead of standing in a crowded queue.

how.question: How does a queue work?
how.answer: A business creates a line and shares its code. A visitor enters that code, joins the line, and can check their live position from their phone.

account.question: Do visitors need an account?
account.answer: No. Visitors can join with a queue code. Contact details are only needed when they choose to receive updates.

install.question: Do I need to install an app?
install.answer: No. LineME works in a web browser, so visitors can open a link or enter a queue code from their phone without installing anything.

turn.question: How will I know when my turn is close?
turn.answer: You can check your live position from your phone. When notifications are enabled, the line can also send updates as your turn gets closer.

who.question: Who can use LineME?
who.answer: Clinics, salons, restaurants, service counters, events, and any team that serves people in an ordered line can use it.

join.title: Join instantly
join.description: Enter a code, see your position, and arrive when it matters.

manage.title: Manage clearly
manage.description: Call the next person, pause intake, and watch demand in real time.

updates.title: Stay informed
updates.description: Send accessible updates that keep everyone aligned without crowding.
